```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)

set.seed(202)
epochs <- 20
training_log <- data.frame(
  Epoch = 1:epochs,
  Train_Loss = round(exp(-seq(0.1, 3, length.out = epochs)), 4),
  Val_Loss = round(exp(-seq(0.1, 2.8, length.out = epochs)), 4),
  MAE = round(0.5 * exp(-seq(0.1, 2.5, length.out = epochs)) + 0.1, 4)
)

datatable(head(training_log, 5), options = list(dom = 't'), rownames = FALSE)

ggplot(training_log, aes(x = Epoch)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Train_Loss, color = "Training Loss"), size = 1.1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Val_Loss, color = "Validation Loss"), size = 1.1, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Training Loss" = "#3498db", "Validation Loss" = "#e74c3c")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(title = "DNN Training Convergence Curve", x = "Epoch", y = "Loss (MSE)", color = "Metric") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
